description: This file defines an abstract generic class 'ObjectGetterBase<T>' used for iterating and inspecting specific elements within a PDF content stream. It provides methods for moving to and retrieving elements of type T based on various criteria, facilitating content stream analysis.

classes.name: ObjectGetterBase<T>
classes.description: Abstract class for iterating specific elements of a content stream for easier inspection.

methods.name: MoveAndGet
methods.description: Moves to previous or next T element in the content stream based on specified steps and criteria, returning the element if found.

methods.name: MoveAndGetNext
methods.description: Moves forward to the next T element and retrieves it.

methods.name: MoveAndGetPrevious
methods.description: Moves backward to the previous T element and retrieves it.
